headline: Uruguay Inaugurates Freight Rail Service With Wabtec Locomotives
summary: Uruguay inaugurated a new freight rail service with an investment introducing seven Wabtec locomotives to haul regional freight including shipments from Argentina, Brazil, and Paraguay.
why: Modernised rail connectivity strengthens Uruguay's role as a primary maritime transshipment hub along the River Plate.

impacts.name: Wabtec
impacts.why: Seven Wabtec locomotives deployed in Uruguay's new cross-border freight rail initiative.
